bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.ID}}')
if [ "$cid" != "9ee9843ecb1e" ]; then printf 'POLLER_CHANGED\n'; exit 72; fi
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),path=require("node:path"),crypto=require("node:crypto");const root="/opt/videobot";function walk(rel){const p=path.join(root,rel),st=fs.lstatSync(p);if(st.isDirectory()){for(const n of fs.readdirSync(p).sort())walk(path.join(rel,n));return}if(!st.isFile()&&!st.isSymbolicLink())return;try{const b=st.isSymbolicLink()?Buffer.from(fs.readlinkSync(p)):fs.readFileSync(p);console.log(crypto.createHash("sha1").update("blob "+b.length+"\0").update(b).digest("hex")+" "+rel)}catch(e){console.log("UNREADABLE "+rel+" "+e.code)}}for(const p of ["src","owner","sql"])walk(p)'
